setup.title: Set up the account
setup.collection: In Bitwarden, create a collection in an organization for Elysia, and move or share into it only the logins agents may use.
setup.account: Use an account that can read that collection. A dedicated account for Elysia keeps your own vault out of reach entirely.
setup.apiKey: In that account's web vault, open Settings, Security, Keys, and choose View API key. Copy client_id and client_secret.
setup.masterPassword: Have the account's master password ready. The CLI needs it to unlock the vault.

overview.failedTitle: The vault is not available to agents
overview.startingDescription: Elysium is signing in and unlocking the vault.

collection.heading: Collection for agents
collection.description: Agents read only the logins in this collection.
collection.label: Collection
collection.loadError: The collections could not be loaded.
collection.notReady: The collections appear once the vault is ready.

remove.title: Remove the vault for {{email}}?
remove.body: Agents lose the vault for {{email}} at their next turn, and Elysium forgets its credentials. The Bitwarden account is untouched; revoke its API key there to be sure it is never used again.

help: The Bitwarden or Vaultwarden account agents sign in to websites and services with. Agents read only the logins in the one collection you choose, never the rest of the vault.
